summary: Improve AutoCAD drawing accuracy, coordination and plotting through five days of practical drafting exercises. Explore the course outline.
lede: AutoCAD precision drafting helps CAD technicians, drafters and design coordinators create accurate, readable drawings ready for review and issue. For professionals with prior CAD exposure, the course provides practice in coordinate control with UCS and Object Snaps, organizing information with layers and blocks, and coordinating references and plot-ready layouts through drawing checks.
audienceIntro: This course suits professionals who edit, coordinate, check or issue AutoCAD drawings as part of design documentation. It is designed for people with prior CAD exposure who want more consistent control over drawing accuracy and output.
prerequisites: Prior experience editing AutoCAD drawings and familiarity with basic drafting commands are expected. You should be comfortable opening and saving DWG files and working with dimensions and drawing layers. No programming is required. Access to an AutoCAD installation is needed for hands-on practice.
